stemMd: A length is reported as (20.0 ± 0.2) cm. What is its relative uncertainty as a percentage?
explanationMd: Relative uncertainty is absolute uncertainty divided by the measured value: 0.2/20.0 = 0.01. Multiplying by 100 converts this to 1%. The units cancel because numerator and denominator are both lengths.

distractorRationale.a: This treats the absolute uncertainty as a percentage directly.
distractorRationale.d: This places the decimal point one place too high.
distractorRationale.c: This doubles the stated uncertainty without justification.
distractorRationale.e: This would mean uncertainty as large as the measured value.
